SECTION.WHEN_HINT: any of these starts the rule

AUTOMATIONS.NO_TRIGGERS: No trigger yet. The rule only runs with Run now.
AUTOMATIONS.NO_CONDITIONS: No conditions, the actions always run.
AUTOMATIONS.NO_CONDITIONS_IN_GROUP: No conditions in this group yet.

SIDE.MODE: If it fires again while running
SIDE.MAX_RUNS_QUEUED: At most this many runs wait in the queue
SIDE.MAX_RUNS_PARALLEL: At most this many runs at the same time

MODE.SINGLE_HINT: New triggers are ignored while a run is active. Right for doorbells and alerts that should not repeat.
MODE.RESTART_HINT: A new trigger stops the active run and starts over, so a delay counts from the last trigger. Right for lights on motion.
MODE.QUEUED_HINT: New triggers wait and run one after another. Right for announcements.
MODE.PARALLEL_HINT: Every trigger starts its own run. Right for counting or logging.

TRIGGER.CONDITIONS_HINT: fires when the conditions become met
TRIGGER.CONTROL_HINT: a switch or dimmer turns on or off

CONDITION.GROUP_HINT: all, any or none of several conditions
CONDITION.CONTROL_HINT: a switch or dimmer is on or off
CONDITION.SHADING_HINT: a blind is shaded right now or not

ACTION.GROUPCONTROL_HINT: e.g. all lights on the ground floor
ACTION.ENABLEAUTOMATION: Switch a rule on or off
ACTION.SHADING_HINT: pause or resume the shading of blinds

FIELD.SHADING_CONDITION_HINT: Shading means the automatic has lowered the blind because of the sun. Checked again every minute.
FIELD.SHADING_ACTION_HINT: Pick blinds one by one, or all blinds of an area or category. Switching on also ends a manual override.
FIELD.VALUE_ANY: true, false, a number or text
FIELD.FROM_ENABLE: Only when the previous value was
FIELD.CONDITIONS_TRIGGER_HINT: Fires once when these conditions change from not met to met.
FIELD.STARTUP_HINT: Fires once after the server has started.
FIELD.TRIGGER_ID_HINT: Shown in the run history and used by "Started by trigger"
FIELD.TIME_WINDOW_HINT: Leave a time empty to check only the other one. After 22:00 and before 06:00 spans midnight.
FIELD.SUN_WINDOW_HINT: After sunset and before sunrise spans midnight and means it is dark. Sun times need the location in the settings.
FIELD.GROUP_CONTROL_HINT: Sends the command to every switch, dimmer and blind in the area and/or category. Controls that do not support it are skipped.
FIELD.CONTINUE_ON_TIMEOUT: Continue the run after the timeout (otherwise it stops)
FIELD.SUBJECT: Subject
FIELD.EMAIL_HINT: Separate several addresses with commas. Empty = notification only.
FIELD.CONTINUE_ON_ERROR: Continue the run if this action fails

GROUP_HINT.ALL: all of these must be met
GROUP_HINT.NOT: none of these may be met

S.RULE: When {{ when }}, only if {{ if }}, then {{ then }}.

SHADING.GLOBAL_HINT: Switches the automatic shading on or off for all blinds
SHADING.NO_LOCATION_HINT: The sun position is calculated from the location of the server. Set latitude and longitude in the settings, or use datapoints of a weather station for the sun.

OVERVIEW.PREVIEW_HINT: Move the slider to see what the shading would do at another time today (clear sky, without wind and rain).

FACADES.DELETE_USED: {{ count }} blinds use the facade "{{ name }}". They keep working only if they have their own direction. Delete anyway?
FACADES.EMPTY_HINT: A facade is a side of the house with its direction, for example south or west. Blinds on the same side share it.
FACADES.BRIGHTNESS_EMPTY: No own sensor, the brightness from the settings is used.
FACADES.GEOMETRY: When the sun reaches the windows
FACADES.MIN_TEMPERATURE: Shade only above an outside temperature of

BLINDS.ADD_HINT: Only blinds from the visualization that are not configured yet are listed.
BLINDS.NONE_AVAILABLE: All blinds are configured already. A blind is a shutter logic block or a blind control.
BLINDS.DELETE_CONFIRM: Remove "{{ name }}" from the automatic shading? The blind itself stays.
BLINDS.EMPTY_HINT: Add the blinds that should close automatically when the sun shines on their window.
BLINDS.RESUME_HINT: Ends the manual override, the automatic takes over again
BLINDS.NOT_LOADED: The blind is not running, check the logic block.
BLINDS.NO_SLAT_OUTPUT: This blind has no slat output, only the height is moved.
BLINDS.OVERRIDE_HINT: Without a tick, the value of the facade is used.

SETTINGS.SUN_HINT: Calculated from the location, or read from a weather station. The first source that has a value wins.
SETTINGS.BRIGHTNESS_HINT: Decides if the sun really shines. Sources are tried top to bottom, a facade can have its own sensor.
SETTINGS.BRIGHTNESS_EMPTY: No source: the shading assumes sun whenever the sun reaches a facade.
SETTINGS.WEATHER_HINT: On wind or rain the blinds go up and stay there until the weather has calmed down.
SETTINGS.WINTER_HINT: In winter the sun may warm the rooms: blinds with "Use the sun in winter" stay open.

FIELD.NAME: Name
FIELD.AZIMUTH_HINT: The direction the windows face: 0° north, 90° east, 180° south, 270° west.
FIELD.GEOMETRY_HINT: The sun reaches the windows when it is within the angle to both sides and between the elevations. Raise the minimum elevation for trees or buildings in front, lower the maximum for a roof overhang.
FIELD.THRESHOLDS_HINT: Bright sun is about 40,000 lx and more, a cloudy day 10,000 lx. The gap between the two values stops the blinds from moving with every cloud.
FIELD.FROST_HINT: Below this temperature the blinds stay where they are, so they cannot freeze.
FIELD.MANUAL_HINT: Moving a blind by hand pauses its automatic. The movement limits stop the blinds from moving too often.
FIELD.RESTORE: Go back to the previous position after the sun
FIELD.POSITIONS_HINT: 0 % is open, 100 % is closed. The travel time is used to know the position while the blind moves.
FIELD.TRACK_SUN: Track the sun with the slats
FIELD.TRACK_SUN_HINT: The slats are tilted just enough to block the direct sun, so as much daylight as possible comes in.
FIELD.SLAT_MAPPING_HINT: Maps the angle to the slat output of the actuator: 0° is horizontal (open), 90° closed.
FIELD.DOOR_CONTACT_HINT: While the door is open, the blind does not go down, so nobody gets locked out.
FIELD.WINTER_GAIN_HINT: In winter the blind stays open on sun, so the sun warms the room.
FIELD.CALCULATED_SUN_HINT: Calculated from the location and the time.
FIELD.CALCULATED_BRIGHTNESS_HINT: Estimated from the sun position (clear sky). With a cloud cover in %, from a weather service for example, the estimate is lowered on clouds.
FIELD.NO_CLOUD_COVER: No cloud cover: clear sky is assumed.
FIELD.IRRADIANCE_HINT: Global irradiance in W/m², from a pyranometer or a weather station. Split into direct and diffuse light per facade.
FIELD.PV_HINT: The current power of a PV system tells how strong the sun is. Only the direction and tilt of the panels must be right.

OVERRIDE.UNTIL_CHANGE: Pause until the sun comes or goes
OVERRIDE.UNTIL_END_OF_DAY: Pause until the end of the day
